rows.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter
rows.summary: Galaxy Medicare Limited has informed regarding Submission of Certificate in relation to Non- Applicability of Compliance Report on the Corporate Governance Pursuant to Regulation 27(2) of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosures Requirements) Regulations, 2015 for the Quarter Ended on 30th September, 2026.
